description: Rollout prediction under 50% synaptic edge ablation. GNN trained with group lasso 25 (condition cond_l25, experiment 2, fold cv00) on dataset flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00, model flyvis_conductance, embedding dim 2, model noise sigma 0.0, 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 500, one-step training, fp32 MLP precision. Regularisers: W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.14, f_theta_weight_L1 0.025. Top row: GNN rollout for 12 cell types over 20 s (1,000 frames, Δt=20 ms); green is ablated ground-truth voltage, black is GNN prediction, red is photoreceptor input. Bottom row: rollout voltage vs. noise-free ablated voltage pooled over all neuron-frame pairs of the 7,999-frame rollout.
facts:
CAPTION: Rollout prediction under 50% edge ablation. General-form GNN (group lasso 25; fold cv00 of experiment 2) evaluated on central 217-column Flyvis data under three model noise regimes (noise-free σ = 0, σ = 0.05, σ = 0.5), tested on held-out stimuli, and compared against the noise-free ablated Flyvis simulation. For each test the simulator regenerates voltage traces with 50% of the synaptic edges zeroed, and the same edge mask is applied to the trained GNN’s learned weights ˆ W before rollout (no retraining). Top row (a, b, c): GNN rollout traces for 12 representative cell types over a 20 s window (1,000 frames at ∆t = 20 ms). Green: ablated ground-truth voltage; black: GNN rollout prediction; red: the visual input of the photoreceptor row. Bottom row (d, e, f): rollout voltage against the noise-free ablated voltage, pooled over all (neuron, frame) pairs of the 7,999-frame rollout as a log-
FACTS:
- experiment: 2: GNN MLP(ai,aj,vi,vj), group lasso, model noise
- arm: cond_l25
- runs: 15 of 15 landed
- cells: noise: noise_free, noise_005, noise_05
- dataset: flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.0
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 500
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32

GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
